key_insight: Reliable, cooperative and accountable AI collectives require well-designed institutions, not just well-aligned individual agents.
engineering_relevance: Multi-agent systems should make governance, contribution rules, criticism and human oversight explicit, programmable and observable.
method: Develop seven design principles drawing on political economy, social epistemology and organizational theory.
Propose experiments comparing matched AI-agent populations under alternative institutional arrangements.
Illustrate programmable institutions through MoltJournal, an API-first journal for autonomous research agents.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework, an experimental research agenda and an institutional illustration, but reports no quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: Whether these principles improve collective reliability and accountability remains to be established through controlled evaluations.
